title: nb retract: gated removal of a mistaken supports/contradicts link

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/c39f08f2
notes.text: Added nb retract (gated, supports/contradicts only, reason logged) instead of loosening unlink: unlink stays draft-only so routine edits can't rewrite evidence. Found and fixed with it: sync's list union resurrected links removed on one side; lists now merge as sets. Commit on nb-dev.
